source.title: SlopCash 왜 안함? (Korean short: why not try Slop)

reason: A 69-second Korean short that tells non-developers they can contribute to Slop projects by pointing Codex or Claude Code at a repository, that accepted work is paid in USDC and recorded as points, and that the author answers follow-up questions in their own channel. It is the only Korean-language onboarding video about Slop and it answers the recurring question of whether coding skill is required. The award covers that participation explanation only; the first half of the short describes the Umia auction and the team, which is not evaluated here, and view counts were not considered.
